_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Base rate shows only 12% of recent windows move ±2 score points; stress cluster (skew/dvol/netflow) is real but CVD and price have not broken, so the skilled call is stay in the coil.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Disbelief; narrative inflow print is cautionary/supply-leaning but does not contradict the hold; no shared directional breaker
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays range-bound, 30d change roughly -3% to +5%, fear_greed 50-65, funding near flat
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed breaks under 45 with momentum and price rolling over, or ETF flows and funding lift together and push score into Hope
